ios.storage.plan.refetch_note.message: Cleared in this order: full-size photos first, thumbnails last. Anything cleared is fetched again when you need it.
ios.storage.plan.refetch_note.context: Note under the clean-up plan. The order is deliberate — the largest and cheapest to re-fetch go first.

ios.storage.plan.shortfall.message: This won't get all the way under your limit
ios.storage.plan.shortfall.context: Warning under a clean-up plan that cannot free enough to reach the chosen cache limit.

ios.storage.plan.total.context: Row label for how much space the planned clean-up would free. The value is a formatted size.

ios.storage.tier.dominant_colour.context: Storage tier: a single color stored for each photo, shown before anything else has loaded.

ios.storage.tier.lqip.context: Storage tier: the very small blurred image kept with each photo's record. Tiny and never cleared, so a photo stays browsable even after everything larger is gone.

ios.storage.title.context: Navigation title of the screen for managing how much space Capsule uses on this device.

ios.sync.action.footer.deferred.message: Large transfers are waiting for a better connection. Sync Now Anyway goes ahead regardless.
ios.sync.action.footer.deferred.context: Section footer under the sync buttons when the connection is holding large work back.

ios.sync.action.footer.unmetered.message: This connection allows everything, including full-size photos.
ios.sync.action.footer.unmetered.context: Section footer under the sync buttons when the connection permits all work.

ios.sync.action.force_now.context: Button that syncs even on a connection the rules would normally hold work back on. It runs with the user's explicit consent — never automatically.

ios.sync.action.snooze.context: Button that puts off the out-of-date warning. It suppresses the warning only; syncing is unaffected.

ios.sync.action.sync_now.context: Button that starts a sync straight away, within the usual connection rules.

ios.sync.auto.enabled.context: Switch that lets Capsule sync on its own in the background.

ios.sync.auto.footer.message: Automatic sync runs when the system gives Capsule time in the background.
ios.sync.auto.footer.context: Section footer under the automatic-sync switches.

ios.sync.auto.section.context: Section header over the automatic-sync switches.

ios.sync.auto.staleness_warning.message: Warn Me If This Device Falls Behind
ios.sync.auto.staleness_warning.context: Switch that controls the warning shown after a long stretch with no completed sync. Turning it off stops the warning only — syncing is unaffected.

ios.sync.criteria.footer.message: These decide when work runs on its own. Sync Now Anyway ignores them.
ios.sync.criteria.footer.context: Section footer under the sync conditions.

ios.sync.criteria.section.context: Section header over the conditions that have to hold before automatic sync does its work.

ios.sync.criterion.background_window.context: Condition covering whether the system has given Capsule time to run in the background.

ios.sync.criterion.background_window.des.message: The system decides when Capsule may work in the background, and it doesn't promise a schedule.
ios.sync.criterion.background_window.des.context: Explanation of the background-time condition. State it plainly — the app cannot control this.

ios.sync.criterion.external_power.context: Condition for very large batches of automatic sync work.

ios.sync.criterion.external_power.descri.message: Very large batches wait until this device is charging.

ios.sync.criterion.non_metered.context: Condition for small automatic sync work.

ios.sync.criterion.non_metered.descripti.message: Details and previews sync on any connection that isn't cellular.

ios.sync.criterion.not_satisfied.context: Standing of a sync condition that currently does not hold.

ios.sync.criterion.satisfied.context: Standing of a sync condition that currently holds.

ios.sync.criterion.unknown.context: Standing of a sync condition Capsule cannot read right now.

ios.sync.criterion.unmetered.context: Condition for large automatic sync work.

ios.sync.cursor.context: Row label for the point in your server's history this device has read up to. The value is a date and time.

ios.sync.cursor.footer.message: Capsule reads changes from your server in order, so an interrupted sync picks up exactly where it stopped.
ios.sync.cursor.footer.context: Section footer under the sync status.

ios.sync.cursor.unset.context: Shown in place of a position when this device hasn't read any of your server's history yet.

ios.sync.empty.description.message: This device is up to date with your server.
ios.sync.empty.description.context: Empty-state description on the sync screen.

ios.sync.empty.title.context: Empty-state title on the sync screen.

ios.sync.last_completed.context: Row label for when this device last finished a sync. The value is a relative time such as '3 days ago'.

ios.sync.last_completed.never.context: Shown in place of a relative time when this device has never completed a sync.

ios.sync.pending.downloads.context: Row label for how many items are still to be downloaded. The value is a formatted number.

ios.sync.pending.none.context: Shown when there is no sync work outstanding.

ios.sync.pending.section.context: Section header over the counts of work still to do.

ios.sync.pending.uploads.context: Row label for how many items are still to be uploaded. The value is a formatted number.

ios.sync.policy.footer.message: Either way, your local copy is kept until the full-size photo is safely stored on your server.
ios.sync.policy.footer.context: Section footer under the upload-order choices. Nothing local is released before storage is confirmed.

ios.sync.policy.full.context: Upload order: everything about a photo is uploaded together.

ios.sync.policy.full.description.message: Uploads the full-size photo along with everything else, as soon as the connection allows.
ios.sync.policy.full.description.context: Explanation of the all-at-once upload order.

ios.sync.policy.section.context: Section header over the choice of how uploads are staged.

ios.sync.policy.staged.context: Upload order: details first, then previews, then the full-size file.

ios.sync.policy.staged.description.message: Sends details and previews first, so photos appear on your other devices quickly, and the full-size file when Wi-Fi is available.
ios.sync.policy.staged.description.context: Explanation of the staged upload order.

ios.sync.scope.empty.description.message: Connect a server to choose what this device keeps.
ios.sync.scope.empty.description.context: Empty-state description on the what-to-sync screen.

ios.sync.scope.empty.title.context: Empty-state title on the what-to-sync screen.

ios.sync.scope.footer.message: Full-size photos are always fetched on demand when you open or share one, whatever you choose here.
ios.sync.scope.footer.context: Section footer under the fetch choices.

ios.sync.scope.metadata_only.context: Fetch option: only each photo's record and its tiny placeholder image.

ios.sync.scope.metadata_only.description.message: Your whole library is browsable, with a small placeholder for each photo. Uses the least space.
ios.sync.scope.metadata_only.description.context: Explanation of the details-only fetch option.

ios.sync.scope.originals.context: Fetch option: records, previews, and the full-size original of every photo.

ios.sync.scope.originals.description.message: Keeps a full-size copy of every photo on this device. Uses the most space.
ios.sync.scope.originals.description.context: Explanation of the everything fetch option.

ios.sync.scope.section.context: Section header over the choice of how much of each photo to download.

ios.sync.scope.thumbnails.context: Fetch option: records plus thumbnails and preview-sized images.

ios.sync.scope.thumbnails.description.message: Adds thumbnails and preview-sized copies, so browsing looks right without keeping full-size files.
ios.sync.scope.thumbnails.description.context: Explanation of the details-and-previews fetch option.

ios.sync.scope.title.context: Navigation title of the screen choosing how much of each photo this device keeps.

ios.sync.scope.unknown.context: Fetch option written by a newer version of Capsule that this one doesn't recognize.

ios.sync.scope.unknown.description.message: A setting a newer version of Capsule wrote. It's kept exactly as it is.
ios.sync.scope.unknown.description.context: Explanation shown for an unrecognized fetch option. The setting is preserved verbatim — never word this as invalid.

ios.sync.snooze.active.context: Shown while the out-of-date reminder is snoozed.

ios.sync.snooze.footer.message: You won't be reminded again for a couple of weeks. Syncing carries on as usual in the meantime.
ios.sync.snooze.footer.context: Footer explaining what snoozing the out-of-date reminder does — and does not — change.

ios.sync.stale.description.message: Capsule hasn't finished a sync in two weeks, and there are still changes to send. On this device the system decides when background work runs, and it hasn't granted any.
ios.sync.stale.description.context: Description of the out-of-date prompt. This is a normal consequence of how background work is scheduled, not a fault.

ios.sync.stale.footer.message: Syncing now uses your current connection, whatever it is. You can also put this reminder off or turn it off in settings.

ios.sync.stale.title.context: Heading of the prompt shown after a long stretch with no completed sync and changes still outstanding.

ios.sync.state.running.context: VoiceOver label for the spinner shown while a sync is running.

ios.sync.status.section.context: Section header over the current sync status.

ios.sync.title.context: Navigation title of the screen showing how up to date this device is.

ios.totp.account.context: Row label for the account name that will appear in the authenticator app.

ios.totp.code.footer.message: Six digits, and they change every 30 seconds.
ios.totp.code.footer.context: Footnote under the authenticator code field.

ios.totp.code.label.context: Field label and placeholder for the six-digit authenticator code.

ios.totp.code.rate_limited.message: Too many attempts — wait a moment before trying again
ios.totp.code.rate_limited.context: Status chip after too many authenticator code attempts.

ios.totp.code.rejected.context: Status chip when the server rejected the entered authenticator code.

ios.totp.confirm.action.context: Primary button that submits the authenticator code and completes setup.

ios.totp.confirm.description.message: Enter the current code from your authenticator app. Nothing changes on your account until it's accepted.
ios.totp.confirm.description.context: Description of the authenticator confirmation step.

ios.totp.confirm.title.context: Heading of the step that checks the authenticator was set up correctly.

ios.totp.confirming.context: Spinner label while the authenticator code is being checked.

ios.totp.done.description.message: You'll be asked for a code from this app when you sign in.
ios.totp.done.description.context: Description of the authenticator success state.

ios.totp.done.title.context: Heading of the success state after an authenticator is enrolled.

ios.totp.issuer.context: Row label for the issuer name that will appear in the authenticator app, which is usually the server.

ios.totp.loading.context: Spinner label while the authenticator setup details are prepared.

ios.totp.manual.note.message: Use this if your authenticator can't scan. Treat it like a password — anyone with it can generate your codes.
ios.totp.manual.note.context: Footnote under the typed setup key.

ios.totp.manual.seed.context: Label above the typed form of the authenticator setup key.

ios.totp.manual.title.context: Title of the collapsed section holding the typed form of the setup key. Collapsed by default, so the key is only on screen when someone deliberately opens it.

ios.totp.subtitle.message: Add your account to an authenticator app, then enter a code to finish.
ios.totp.subtitle.context: Subtitle of the authenticator setup screen. Nothing is switched on until the code is confirmed.

ios.totp.title.context: Heading of the screen that enrolls a time-based one-time-code app as a sign-in factor.

ios.totp.unavailable.description.message: This server doesn't offer authenticator codes.
ios.totp.unavailable.description.context: Empty-state description when authenticator setup is unavailable.

ios.totp.unavailable.title.context: Empty-state title when this server does not offer authenticator codes.

ios.transfer.action.cancel.context: Destructive button or swipe action that cancels one upload. Only offered where cancelling is actually possible.

ios.transfer.action.force_now.context: Toolbar button that starts waiting uploads immediately, ignoring the connection rules that would otherwise hold them back.

ios.transfer.action.retry.context: Button that repeats a failed read on a transfer screen.

ios.transfer.activity.empty.context: Shown in place of the recent-activity list when it is empty.

ios.transfer.chunk.bounds.context: Row label for the range of piece sizes the server accepts.

ios.transfer.chunk.bounds.range.context: A range of sizes: smallest, then largest, both already formatted. Translate the separator if your language uses a different one; keep both values.

ios.transfer.chunk.current.context: Row label for the size Capsule is currently uploading in. The value is a formatted size.

ios.transfer.chunk.misaligned.message: Piece size doesn't line up with the server's requirement
ios.transfer.chunk.misaligned.context: Warning in the upload-pieces diagnostics when the chosen size is not a size the server will accept.

ios.transfer.chunk.reason.adverse.message: Kept small while the connection is poor
ios.transfer.chunk.reason.adverse.context: Reason for the current upload piece size.

ios.transfer.chunk.reason.held.context: Reason for the current upload piece size.

ios.transfer.chunk.reason.lowered.message: Lowered because the connection is struggling
ios.transfer.chunk.reason.lowered.context: Reason for the current upload piece size.

ios.transfer.chunk.reason.raised.message: Raised because the connection is keeping up
ios.transfer.chunk.reason.raised.context: Reason for the current upload piece size.

ios.transfer.chunk.reason.unmeasured.message: Not enough transferred yet to measure
ios.transfer.chunk.reason.unmeasured.context: Reason for the current upload piece size, before any speed measurement exists.

ios.transfer.chunk.reason.warming_up.message: Starting small until the speed settles
ios.transfer.chunk.reason.warming_up.context: Reason for the current upload piece size.

ios.transfer.chunk.suggested.context: Row label for the piece size the server recommends. The value is a formatted size.

ios.transfer.chunk.title.context: Title of the collapsed section holding upload chunk-size diagnostics. Detail for someone investigating a slow upload, not a setting.

ios.transfer.chunk.window.context: Row label for how many seconds of transfer Capsule averages before adjusting. The value is a plain number.

ios.transfer.connection.adverse.context: Chip naming a connection that works but is slow or unreliable.

ios.transfer.connection.constrained.context: Chip naming a connection the system has asked apps to go easy on.

ios.transfer.connection.metered.context: Chip naming a metered connection, where large transfers are held back.

ios.transfer.connection.offline.context: Chip naming the absence of a usable connection.

ios.transfer.connection.policy.adverse.message: Only small details upload while the connection is poor.
ios.transfer.connection.policy.adverse.context: One-line transfer policy for a poor connection.

ios.transfer.connection.policy.constrain.message: Only details and previews upload on this connection.
ios.transfer.connection.policy.constrain.context: One-line transfer policy while the system has asked apps to limit data use.

ios.transfer.connection.policy.metered.context: One-line transfer policy for a metered connection. This sentence is the whole staged-upload contract — keep it short and concrete.

ios.transfer.connection.policy.offline.message: Nothing uploads until you're back online.

ios.transfer.connection.policy.unknown.message: Capsule is being cautious until it can tell what this connection is.
ios.transfer.connection.policy.unknown.context: One-line transfer policy while the connection kind is unknown.

ios.transfer.connection.policy.unmetered.context: One-line transfer policy for an unmetered connection.

ios.transfer.connection.unknown.context: Chip shown when the kind of connection can't be determined.

ios.transfer.connection.unmetered.context: Chip naming an unmetered connection, where every kind of transfer is allowed.

ios.transfer.detail.declared_size.context: Row label for the total size of the upload. The value is a formatted size.

ios.transfer.detail.empty.description.message: This photo has no uploads in progress.
ios.transfer.detail.empty.description.context: Empty-state description on the upload detail screen.

ios.transfer.detail.empty.title.context: Empty-state title on the upload detail screen.

ios.transfer.detail.failures.context: Section header over failed uploads and the action each one needs.

ios.transfer.detail.ladder.context: Section header over the list of upload stages for one photo.

ios.transfer.detail.progress.context: VoiceOver label for one upload's progress bar. The spoken value is a percentage.

ios.transfer.detail.resume_at.context: Row label for the point an interrupted upload will continue from. The value is a formatted size.

ios.transfer.detail.throughput.context: Row label for the current upload speed.

ios.transfer.detail.title.context: Navigation title of the screen showing one photo's upload in detail.

ios.transfer.downloads.ladder.message: Details arrive first, then previews, then full-size photos — each when the connection allows it.
ios.transfer.downloads.ladder.context: Footnote explaining the order in which Capsule fetches things.

ios.transfer.downloads.none.context: Shown when nothing is waiting to download.

ios.transfer.downloads.pending.context: Row label for how many items this device is still waiting to receive. The value is a formatted number.

ios.transfer.empty.description.message: Everything on this device is stored on your server.
ios.transfer.empty.description.context: Empty-state description on the transfers screen.

ios.transfer.empty.title.context: Empty-state title on the transfers screen when everything is up to date.

ios.transfer.policy.staged.message: Full-size photos are uploaded after the details and previews.
ios.transfer.policy.staged.context: Note shown when this device uploads in stages rather than all at once.

ios.transfer.recovery.merge.context: Button label for the fix when the server already holds identical contents.

ios.transfer.recovery.merge.description.message: The server already has these exact contents. Capsule will point this photo at them instead of uploading again.

ios.transfer.recovery.realign.context: Button label for the fix when the server and this device disagree about how much has been uploaded. The label names the actual fix rather than saying 'Retry'.

ios.transfer.recovery.realign.descriptio.message: Asks the server how much it has, then continues from there.

ios.transfer.recovery.refresh.context: Button label for the fix when this device is working from stale information.

ios.transfer.recovery.refresh.descriptio.message: Capsule will fetch the current state from your server and try again.

ios.transfer.recovery.report.context: Button label for a failure that is a fault in the app rather than anything the user did.

ios.transfer.recovery.report.description.message: This is a fault in Capsule, not something you did. A report helps get it fixed.

ios.transfer.recovery.resend_chunk.context: Button label for the fix when a piece of the upload arrived damaged.

ios.transfer.recovery.resend_chunk.descr.message: Part of the upload didn't arrive intact. Capsule will send that piece again.

ios.transfer.recovery.restart_session.context: Button label for the fix when the server no longer has this upload in progress.

ios.transfer.recovery.restart_session.de.message: The server no longer has this upload. Capsule will start a fresh one.

ios.transfer.recovery.retry.context: Button label for a failure that usually clears on its own.

ios.transfer.recovery.retry.description.message: This usually clears on its own. Capsule will wait a moment and try again.

ios.transfer.recovery.review.context: Button label for a failure only a person can settle. It opens the relevant screen rather than acting.

ios.transfer.recovery.review.description.message: This one needs a decision from you.

ios.transfer.recovery.update_app.context: Button label for the one failure a person can only fix by updating the app.

ios.transfer.recovery.update_app.descrip.message: This version can't talk to your server any more. Updating fixes it.

ios.transfer.row.capture_date_pending.context: Shown in place of a photo's capture date on a transfer row before the date has been read. Photos are identified by capture date here because no filename is ever uploaded.

ios.transfer.row.progress.context: VoiceOver label for a transfer row's progress bar. The spoken value is a percentage.

ios.transfer.row.throughput.context: VoiceOver label for a transfer row's speed readout.

ios.transfer.row.throughput_measuring.context: Shown in place of a speed before enough has transferred to measure one. Deliberately not '0 B/s' — a stalled transfer and an unmeasured one are different facts.

ios.transfer.segment.activity.context: Segment and section header for transfers that have already settled.

ios.transfer.segment.downloads.context: Segment and section header for what this device is waiting to receive.

ios.transfer.segment.label.context: Label of the segmented control choosing between uploads, downloads, and recent activity. Visually hidden, so it exists for VoiceOver.

ios.transfer.segment.uploads.context: Segment and section header for transfers leaving this device.

ios.transfer.session.completed.context: State of one upload: finished and confirmed stored on the server.

ios.transfer.session.failed.context: State of one upload: the server could not finish it.

ios.transfer.session.failed.description.message: The server couldn't finish this upload. Your local copy is untouched.
ios.transfer.session.failed.description.context: Explanation of a failed upload. Say plainly that the copy on this device is unaffected.

ios.transfer.session.pending.context: State of one upload: created but not started.

ios.transfer.session.track.context: VoiceOver label for the row of steps showing how far one upload has got.

ios.transfer.session.unknown.context: Upload state written by a newer version of Capsule that this one doesn't recognize.

ios.transfer.session.uploading.context: State of one upload: bytes are moving.

ios.transfer.session.waiting.context: State of one upload: every byte has arrived and the server is finishing up.

ios.transfer.session.waiting.description.message: Your photo has arrived. The server is finishing up — it can't read the contents.
ios.transfer.session.waiting.description.context: Explanation of the finishing-on-the-server upload state.

ios.transfer.state.error.title.context: Title of the failure state on transfer screens. The specific reason is shown underneath.

ios.transfer.state.loading.context: Label on the spinner shown while a transfer screen loads.

ios.transfer.state.offline.description.message: Transfers will pick up where they left off once you're back online. Nothing is lost in the meantime.
ios.transfer.state.offline.description.context: Description of the offline state on transfer screens. Uploads resume rather than restart, so the copy must not suggest lost work.

ios.transfer.state.offline.inline.message: Offline — transfers will resume on their own
ios.transfer.state.offline.inline.context: One-line offline notice inside a transfer detail screen.

ios.transfer.state.offline.title.context: Title of the offline state on transfer screens.

ios.transfer.tier.index.context: Name of the first upload stage, which carries an asset's signed record and its tiny placeholder image. Small enough to go over any working connection.

ios.transfer.tier.index.description.message: The photo's record and a tiny placeholder. Uploads on any working connection.
ios.transfer.tier.index.description.context: Explanation of the details upload stage.

ios.transfer.tier.original.context: Name of the third upload stage, which carries the original file.

ios.transfer.tier.original.description.message: The original file. Waits for Wi-Fi unless you upload now.
ios.transfer.tier.original.description.context: Explanation of the full-size upload stage.

ios.transfer.tier.preview.context: Name of the second upload stage, which carries thumbnails and a preview-sized image.

ios.transfer.tier.preview.description.message: Thumbnails and a preview-sized copy. Uploads on any connection that isn't cellular.
ios.transfer.tier.preview.description.context: Explanation of the preview upload stage.

ios.transfer.tier.standing.idle.context: Standing of an upload stage with nothing waiting. Said in words because an empty progress ring can't tell 'nothing queued' from 'everything sent'.

ios.transfer.tier.standing.in_flight.context: Standing of an upload stage that is currently transferring.

ios.transfer.tier.standing.settled.context: Standing of an upload stage that has finished everything queued for it.

ios.transfer.tier.standing.waiting.context: Standing of an upload stage that has work queued but is held back by the current connection.

ios.transfer.title.context: Navigation title of the screen showing uploads, downloads, and recent transfer activity.

ios.transfer.unit.per_second.context: Transfer speed. %@ is an already-formatted amount of data, such as '1.2 MB'. Translate the per-second part to whatever your language uses; keep %@.

ios.transfer.upgrade.data_safe.message: Nothing has been lost. Your library is readable and every local copy is intact.
ios.transfer.upgrade.data_safe.context: Reassurance on the update-required screen. Load-bearing: a hard stop on uploads must not read as data loss.

ios.transfer.upgrade.explanation.message: Your server has moved on to a version this app doesn't speak. There's nothing to negotiate — updating Capsule is the fix.

ios.transfer.upgrade.link.message: This version can't upload to your server
ios.transfer.upgrade.link.context: Row that opens the update-required screen from an upload's detail.

ios.transfer.upgrade.no_channel.message: Update Capsule however you installed it.
ios.transfer.upgrade.no_channel.context: Shown in place of an update button when the app has no way to start an update itself.

ios.transfer.upgrade.title.context: Title of the screen shown when this build and the server no longer share a protocol version.

ios.transfer.uploads.empty.context: Shown in place of the upload list when nothing is uploading.
